description: This operation always evaluates to true
fullDescription: This binary operation always evaluates to `true` regardless of the runtime value of its operands, based on the semantics of the operator and a constant operand (e.g. comparisons against `int:MAX_VALUE`/`float:Infinity`, or short-circuiting with a literal `true`/`false`). This is usually unintended and indicates dead logic or a mistake in the condition.
